t: This is the West London Free School, a free school for girls and boys aged eleven to eighteen, in Hammersmith and Fulham. It opened in 2011, and Toby Young co-founded it, which is why his name comes up here. Young is a British journalist and social commentator, now a Conservative life peer. He also founded the Free Speech Union, is an associate editor of The Spectator, and created The Daily Sceptic blog.
